Reference / runtime/cldr

runtime/cldr#

The native layer under locale/internal/currencies, locale/internal/day_periods, locale/internal/gregorian, locale/internal/likely: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under locale/internal/currencies, locale/internal/day_periods, locale/internal/gregorian, locale/internal/likely: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

CLDR tables as runtime data (#223). tools/generate-cldr*.py write them to cldr-<family>.dat; the runtime reads a file the first time one of its tables is asked for. A table name starts with its family and a dot ("numbers.row"); an unknown table is refused.

Public API#

native cldr_fields#

native cldr_fields(table is string, key is string) is @string

The fields of a record; empty when the table has no such key.

native cldr_field#

native cldr_field(table is string, key is string, index is int) is string

One field of a record, counted from 0; a failure when there is none (#943).

native cldr_size#

native cldr_size(table is string, key is string) is int

How many fields a record has; 0 when the table has no such key.
